exact_statement: For any finite uniform Boolean root f and fixed signed root character c, let Z={f!=c}. In any finite adaptive tree of actual single-coordinate restrictions with arbitrary branch-dependent invertible affine input/output-character resets, transport c through exactly the same maps. If tau is path query count, dbar=E tau and a=E[1_Z tau], then a=sum_internal reach*P(Z|node), and for dbar>0 the complete entropy decrement satisfies H(f)-E H(leaves)<=dbar phi(min(2a/dbar,1/2)), phi(x)=h2(x)+2x/ln2; zero-query case is zero. If resets do not increase actual influence, writing Q+R=I(f)-E I(leaves) and S_leaf=E[K I(leaves)-H(leaves)] gives D_K(f)+S_leaf+K(Q+R)=H(f)-E H(leaves) at every K>=0. The maximum-depth bound cannot in general replace maximum depth by E tau: for any canonical nonconstant d-bit seed, activate t=2^k disjoint copies on k zero controls and query controls until first1, otherwise query all dt data bits. Every terminal is constant; E tau=d+2(1-2^-k), while a=[2^-k(1-mu^t)/2](k+dt) tends d/2 and H(root) tends H(seed). For bent2,k10,t1024 the actual finite2058-bit formula has E tau=2047/512, entropy loss>=1933/1024 and D_1>=889/1024, whereas the false expected-depth substitution gives an upper budget<116/1024.
